{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column
print("Original revenue data:")
print(data['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for non-numeric characters
print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].unique())

# Check for the presence of commas (thousands separators)
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the '999999.99' sentinel values
sentinel_count = (data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue = '999999.99': {sentinel_count}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")"}
